notes.title: 0.7.493 Update - Fix stuttering bug
notes.notes:
After upgrading Godot from version 3.5 to 3.6, gameplay stuttering occurred due to changes in engine logic.

To address frame drops and stuttering, the following optimizations were implemented, resulting in smoother performance surpassing the original 3.5 version. However, experimental engine features were enabled, and potential long-term stability risks remain unverified.

[h3]‌Optimizations for GODOT Stuttering Issues:‌[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduced fixed physics iterations per frame to lower computational overhead.
[*] Experimentally enabled ‌[Physics Jitter Fix]‌ and ‌[Physics Interpolation]‌ features (unknown long-term stability risks).
[*] Fixed severe frame drops when using a controller alongside keyboard input.
[*] Modified character types experimentally to reduce physics-related resource consumption.
[/list]

[h3]‌Other Updates:‌[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted parameters (e.g., bear projectile mechanics) due to reduced physics iterations.
[*] Fixed inability to throw boxes when the bear character is stationary.
[*] Resolved text display issue ({Lux}) in the tutorial section.
[*] Fixed incorrect order interface images.
[/list]

notes.title: Regarding Feedback Concerning Steam Connectivity and Game Loading Issues
notes.notes:
Dear Esteemed Players, good morning! Wishing you a delightful weekend!

Recently, we have noted feedback from some players indicating that they have encountered issues such as "unable to connect to Steam" or "the game cannot be loaded and run properly" while experiencing *Feed the Cups*.

Following investigation, we have identified that a potential cause may be related to players' Steam accounts having previously purchased game programs from other platforms. Launching these games might have involved the use of modified programs provided by vendors, thereby affecting certain Steam data.

This altered data may lead to similar problems occurring with games developed using the Godot engine. Even updating to the latest version of Steam might not resolve these issues.

Currently, the proposed solution is to uninstall and then reinstall the Steam platform.

It is important to note that if software that modifies Steam program data continues to be used in the future, such problems may still arise.

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused you. As this issue is related to the underlying mechanisms of the game engine, we, as game developers, face technical limitations in directly resolving it. We earnestly request players encountering this problem to try uninstalling and reinstalling Steam so that they can continue to enjoy *Feed the Cups*.

Thank you for your understanding and continued support! Wishing you a pleasant gaming weekend!

notes.title: News: Latest Preview Report on the Fashion System
notes.notes:
[h3]‌▶︎ Author:‌ Hello dear Café Managers![/h3]
Today, we interviewed Little Devil to unveil new features for Feed the Cups! Now, Little Devil, could you introduce today's announcement?‌

[h3]‌◉ Little Devil:‌[/h3]
During last year's ‌Christmas‌, this year's ‌New Year's Day‌, ‌Valentine's Day‌, and ‌Chinese New Year‌, everyone wore ‌special holiday outfits‌. If you logged into the ‌leaderboard‌ on those holidays, you'll unlock these outfits in the upcoming ‌Fashion System‌.
I'm thrilled to announce that the ‌Fashion System‌, powered by ‌Steam Inventory Service‌, will launch soon!
You can dress each character with customizable outfit pieces. These will be visible in ‌single-player mode, local co-op, and online multiplayer‌ — both at home and in your café. However, ‌functional equipment purchased for the café will override outfit displays‌ (café uniforms must follow dress code policies, after all!).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43770998/e82c2dc5296cec213027b62de8648c0c60bd772e.png[/img]

[h3]▶︎ Author:‌ You mentioned that each character can equip outfits in different slots. Could you elaborate?[/h3]
[h3]‌◉ Little Devil:‌[/h3]
Outfit slots are divided into ‌Head‌ (hats), ‌Face‌ (masks), ‌Body‌ (clothing), ‌Hands‌ (gloves), ‌Legs‌ (shoes), and ‌Accessories‌ (multi-part items).
Each character can equip ‌6 slots‌.
Exceptions:
‌Ghosts‌ cannot equip ‌Hands‌ or ‌Legs‌ but get ‌2 extra Accessories‌.
‌Slimes‌ cannot equip ‌Legs‌ and gain ‌1 extra Accessory‌.
Note: Only ‌1 Accessory per slot‌ will be displayed if multiple are equipped.

[h3]‌▶︎ Author:‌ How do players unlock the Fashion System?[/h3]
[h3]‌◉ Little Devil:‌[/h3]
Three new furniture items will be added:
‌Wardrobe‌: Unlocks ‌Body‌ and ‌Accessories‌ slots.
‌Coat Rack‌: Unlocks ‌Head‌ and ‌Face‌ slots.
‌Shoe Cabinet‌: Unlocks ‌Hands‌ and ‌Legs‌ slots.

[h3]‌▶︎ Author:‌ How are outfits obtained?[/h3]
[h3]‌◉ Little Devil:‌[/h3]
The ‌Fashion System‌ uses ‌Steam Inventory Service‌.
Play ‌30 minutes daily‌ and ‌upload scores to the leaderboard‌ to earn a random outfit.
New outfits arrive via ‌mailbox notifications‌ in-game.
‌10-hour cooldown‌ per unlock during testing.
‌Legacy rewards‌: Players who logged into leaderboards during ‌Christmas 2023‌, ‌2024 New Year‌, ‌Valentine’s Day‌, or ‌Chinese New Year‌ will automatically receive ‌holiday-themed outfits‌ (e.g., Santa hats for all unlocked characters).

[h3]‌▶︎ Author:‌ What happens to duplicate outfits?[/h3]
[h3]‌◉ Little Devil:‌[/h3]
Duplicates can be ‌dismantled into materials‌ for future use.
Current limitation: Due to a bug in ‌GodotSteam 3.6‌, dismantling is temporarily disabled. We’re working with the GodotSteam team to resolve this.
[Note: Original design included "outfit gift boxes" unlocked post-match, but we simplified it due to engine constraints.]

[h3]‌▶︎ Author:‌ Can outfits be traded on Steam Market?[/h3]
[h3]‌◉ Little Devil:‌[/h3]
‌Not yet‌: GodotSteam’s inventory issues prevent market integration.
‌Testing-phase outfits‌ will be ‌permanently retained‌.
Market and trading features may be added post-launch.

[h3]‌▶︎ Author:‌ When will the Fashion System beta begin?[/h3]
[h3]‌◉ Little Devil:‌[/h3]
Core features are ready: outfit acquisition, mail alerts, customization UI, multiplayer sync, etc.
Beta launches after final optimizations and additional outfit designs.
‌Engine upgraded to GodotSteam 3.6‌ (from 3.5) to fix inventory bugs, but expect potential quirks during testing.

notes.title: 致玩家的一封信
notes.notes:
尊敬的玩家们：

我是熊熊，《杯杯倒满》开发组的一员。是《杯杯倒满》让我有机会和你们每个人相遇，而我却用它伤害了许多支持过我们的玩家。在经过思考和反省后，我想要再次向你们表达我的歉疚。

我在3月份的访谈视频中提及“游戏偏硬核不适合女生”，并在面对质疑时，情绪化地使用了“拳师”等词语，这些言论给女性玩家造成了巨大的不适感。而我却自以为是，也没有意识到自己态度和认识不端，让大家一再失望。我们还曾在社区中表达“提需求就延期”、“不用敬语”等傲慢的言论，伤害到了热爱游戏的玩家，非常抱歉。

工作室开发《杯杯倒满》的初心，是制作一款基于现实饮品店经营过程的合作模拟游戏，并希望每位玩家都能在这个过程中体验到乐趣。但因我们的错误观念和言论，伤害了女性玩家们的情感，破坏了大家的游戏体验，也违背了我们一开始制作游戏的初衷。如果大家不能在《杯杯倒满》中收获轻松快乐的体验，那我们制作的游戏也将失去意义。

为了弥补我们的过错，也为了表达痛定思痛的决心，经过商议，《杯杯倒满》开发组做出了以下决定：

[olist]
[*] 调整开发组内部工作结构和工作模式，熊熊将仅专注于自己的本职工作，不再参与社区运营，并虚心接受大家的意见，以示对错误言论的反省。

[*] 为女性组织及慈善机构捐款，我们将以实际行动支持女性权益，将《杯杯倒满》游戏的部分收入捐赠给相关的组织机构，加强自己对性别平等、文化多样性以及社会包容性的理解和认识。（本次捐赠金额为 50 万元人民币，相关的捐赠结果我们会在近期完成后与大家公示）

[*] 加入更多游戏内容的更新，我们承诺保持更新频率，并将在正式版中为大家带来更多的游玩内容与更良好的游戏体验，在未来合适的时候以一切可能的方式回馈支持过我们的每位玩家。
[/olist]

另外，我们开发组在此作出说明：我们将暂时停止运营所有对外发声的渠道，包括但不限于直播、采访、社群等。我们将把全部精力集中在游戏开发上，以更快地做出更多、更好的内容。

最后，再次向所有受到伤害的玩家们致以最诚挚的歉意，我们将努力改正自己的错误，重新树立正确的价值观。不奢求原谅，但我们会努力进步，在未来呈现出更好的自己与游戏。

熊熊 & 《杯杯倒满》开发组


---------------
关于原公告中提到的 “将本体内容陆续更新至 demo” 这一做法，我们收到了许多反馈，在此为失误的决策向大家致歉。目前我们决定删除这一条内容，准备其他的补偿方案。

《杯杯倒满》自发售以来得到了许多玩家的支持，这让我们这个小小的独立游戏开发组受宠若惊，非常感谢你们。

notes.title: Frequently Asked Questions Q&A for "Feed the Cups"
notes.notes:
Hello fellow players, we have sorted out some frequently asked questions since its release, including online connections, discounts, cloud saving, etc.! Come and see if there are any answers that can answer your questions~

[olist]

[*]Will it be available on Switch? How about Mac?

Answer: It's in the planning stages, but it won't be realized in the short term. It's likely to follow the completion of the official version. Currently, many Mac users play by installing a virtual machine. Those eager to try it out now might consider this workaround.

[*]When will there be discounts? Will it participate in the spring promotion?

Answer: The discount is available now!  At the next Steam event (the Steam Endless Replayability Fest in May), we'll offer discounts, as well as during the summer promotion.

[*]Will the multiplayer pack be available again? When? Why not offer it directly on Steam?

Answer: This won't happen in the short term. Previously, our request for a large number of keys in a short period wasn't approved by Steam. So, we'll prepare well in advance next time, but it certainly won't be in the near future. Following the overhaul of Steam's gift mechanism, the multiplayer pack feature was discontinued, except for some older games. New games released after 2020 cannot use this feature.

[*]Will the price increase with the official release?

Answer: Given the additional content and enhanced overall functionality of the official version, there might be a slight price increase.

[*]Isn't the current version the official release? Will I have to pay again later?

Answer: You're currently accessing the Early Access version. Once we update the game with more content and consider it complete, we will launch the official version. Those who have already purchased it won't have to pay again; the game will automatically upgrade to the official version for existing Early Access players.

[*]How can I play locally in multiplayer mode?

Answer: Through the room's bed.

[*]Why can't the second player in local multiplayer earn experience points?

Answer: Local multiplayer is built on a single-player logic. Hence, the second player, operating without independent logic, earns no experience points. It's a technical challenge we plan to explore further.

[*]Why can't I play local and online multiplayer simultaneously?

Answer: Refer to the previous response. The second player lacks independent logic and cannot earn experience points. Multiplayer is based on single-player logic. Currently, it's not feasible to synchronize local two-player and online multiplayer. As developers who started self-learning programming only in the past two years, we'll consider this if we overcome the related technical challenges, though it's highly complex and not guaranteed.

[*]When will new levels and characters be released?
Due to the number of players entering the game exceeding our expectations, many bugs that we hadn't discovered before have emerged. We are urgently fixing these bugs and, once things are more stable, we will fully commit to creating new content. You can follow the developer's livestream; they might be working on the game live every afternoon. (https://space.bilibili.com/28435240?spm_id_from=333.337.search-card.all.click)


[*]Can the demo and the early access version of the game be played online together?
No, they cannot be played online together because the versions are different. Demos can connect with demos, and the full version can connect with the full version.


[*]Why does it say the version is different when I try to play online with a friend?
Check in your Steam game library to see if the name of the game you're launching includes the word "Demo". If you're both launching the full version, make sure you've updated to the latest version. If there's no update prompt, try exiting Steam and re-entering.


[*]Regarding cloud saves, there's an issue with rollbacks on different computers.
You can check the developer's "Comprehensive Guide to Using Cloud Saves" here: https://pd.qq.com/s/m5y3ru4r


[*]Playing solo feels very hard; is it really possible to beat the game?
It's definitely possible. The game's publishing team's social media personnel have personally tested and confirmed that it's possible to beat the game solo.

[*]Why is my controller not working (or some buttons are unresponsive), but it works fine with other games?

notes.title: DEMO 1.1.0 Update
notes.notes:
[h3]First of all, we would like to thank everyone for their support of Feed the Cups. We have received a lot of feedback from players.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43770998/432750ea83376a7bdbed6840ae561ed4c61778f8.png[/img]

[h1][b]Based on the feedback, we have worked tirelessly to optimize the following:[/b][/h1]

We have redesigned the [b]beginner's tutorial[/b] and added more comprehensive teaching levels, hoping that each player can experience every aspect of running their own beverage shop.

We have added a function in the settings to [b]turn off the lighting effect[/b], which can significantly improve performance.

We have added a function in the settings to [b]adjust the viewing distance[/b], making it possible to see everything more clearly.

We have added a prompt in the upper right corner for [b]order funds deduction[/b] (be careful of getting into debt). There's also a prompt on the phone when inventory is low.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43770998/22e5655ffd5e9ea5a23d784e4c3ab3d8f7e773e2.png[/img]

[b]Cups[/b] can now [b]swap order numbers[/b], so if you make a mistake, you can exchange the order numbers between cups!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43770998/2f09f18a63133f647034174d2377340e63fb5ae8.gif[/img]

There is now a chance of [b]splashing liquid[/b] when [b]pouring[/b] drinks, which can dirty the floor. If there are too many spills, footprints will be left behind!
[Spoiler]Later levels will have slippery or sticky stains from spills, but this cannot be experienced in the demo version.[/spoiler]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43770998/80aa5b35070c1354a5e331251e4820e7fb826478.png[/img]

After taking [b]items[/b] out of a box, they can now be [b]put back into the box[/b] (but not into other boxes).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43770998/24b13dae5769bd7dd2f358b3f4c1e5602e07a5ab.gif[/img]

[b]Dismantling boxes[/b] no longer directly [b]becomes[/b] a trash bag, but a [b]flattened cardboard box[/b].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43770998/a46ac44c4d2f9d6c8a8dd66abc8f431c3aeae810.gif[/img]

[b]Equipment[/b] is no longer limited to moving prior to opening, and can [b]now be moved at any time[/b] (make sure to switch off electrical equipment!).

We have fixed hundreds and thousands of bugs, but there may be new unknown bugs to discover (-_-||).

[hr][/hr]

We thank everyone for their support and affirmation of the game, and hope to hear more feedback from players!

Please feel free to subscribe to stay informed about our latest developments, and don't forget to add it to your wishlist!
